scripts.test:e2e: E2E_GROUP=vite playwright test && E2E_GROUP=nextjs playwright test && E2E_GROUP=nextjs-app playwright test
scripts.version:commit: git add packages/*/package.json && git commit -m "Bump version to $(node -p "require('./packages/core/package.json').version")"
scripts.tag: git tag v$(node -p "require('./packages/core/package.json').version") && git push origin v$(node -p "require('./packages/core/package.json').version")
scripts.release:patch: pnpm version:patch && pnpm version:commit && pnpm publish:all && pnpm tag
scripts.release:minor: pnpm version:minor && pnpm version:commit && pnpm publish:all && pnpm tag
scripts.release:major: pnpm version:major && pnpm version:commit && pnpm publish:all && pnpm tag
